typography.headings: Inter or system sans (based on existing brand config), font-semibold for active states

colors.surface: Solid backgrounds for overlays; no complete transparent backgrounds.

visual_enhancers: Subtle hover states on icon buttons (bg-black/5 or bg-white/10)

layouts.mobile: Vertical stack (flex-col). Row 1: Mode Switcher & Primary Actions (Quick Create, Bell, Kebab). Row 2: Module Switcher (horizontal scroll). Row 3: Full-width Global Search.
layouts.desktop: Horizontal row (flex-row). Left-to-right: Module Switcher, Mode Switcher, Search, Action Buttons (right-aligned).

instructions_to_main_agent: Modify the <div data-testid='crm-toolbar'> to use responsive flex direction: `flex flex-col md:flex-row`.
Group the CRMModeSwitcher and Action Icons into a top row on mobile using `flex justify-between items-center w-full md:w-auto`.
Keep Quick Create and Notifications visible on mobile. Move Staff Filter, AI Tools, and Settings into a 'More' kebab menu on mobile (< 768px).
Use a lucide-react `MoreVertical` icon for the mobile kebab menu trigger.
The mobile dropdown menu MUST have a solid background (e.g., `bg-white dark:bg-gray-900`) and NOT be completely transparent.
Wrap the ModuleSwitcher in a `w-full md:w-auto overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar` container so it scrolls horizontally on small screens instead of wrapping and cramping.
Render the GlobalSearchBar inline on desktop (`md:block md:flex-1`) and full-width below the module switcher on mobile (`w-full`).
Ensure the overflow dropdown maintains accessibility with z-index (`z-50`) and shadow (`shadow-lg`).

implementation_blueprint.toolbar_container: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center gap-3 w-full mb-4
implementation_blueprint.mobile_top_row: flex items-center justify-between w-full md:w-auto gap-2 order-1
implementation_blueprint.overflow_menu_trigger: md:hidden w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center border c-border rounded-md hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer
implementation_blueprint.overflow_dropdown: absolute right-0 top-12 w-48 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border c-border rounded-md shadow-lg p-2 flex flex-col gap-2 z-50
implementation_blueprint.module_switcher_wrapper: w-full md:w-auto overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar pb-1 md:pb-0 order-2 md:order-1
implementation_blueprint.desktop_actions_group: hidden md:flex ml-auto items-center gap-2 order-4

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
